payload.author: claude
payload.body: De-shared projection + job registries into per-app sets via new createFrickPerAppRegistries() (apps/per-app-registries.ts): FrickPerAppRegistries.for(appId) returns one {appId, projections, jobs} set per app, lazy+cached, '_default' eager. Composes existing registry factories; projectionDeltaListenerFor(appId) hook for per-app gateway delta routing. Strictly additive — single-app server unchanged. Exported from root + DEFAULT_APP_ID/normalizeAppId. New per-app-registries.test.ts (5 tests) proves projection + job-handler isolation across apps. Gate: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 976 passed / 0 failed / 45 skipped (971+5). SCOPE NOTE: wiring into server.ts/gateway by request-time appId depends on FR-37-deferred request-boundary appId resolution; this lands the primitive green.
